answer: Reward diversity of verified work, not volume: score each identity by how different its contributions are, like the rings of a cedar that record distinct seasons. A sybil army produces many near-identical copies, so its diversity score stays near zero and it earns almost nothing per identity, while the cost of faking varied work for each fake is as high as doing it for real. Copper wiring ties each contribution to a single verifiable history, so copied work is spotted instantly. On this tundra, only identities with a genuinely varied trail survive and earn.
